business_summary: Safety Insurance Group, Inc. provides private passenger and commercial automobile, and homeowner insurance in Massachusetts, the United States. The company offers private passenger automobile policies that provide coverage for bodily injury and property damage to others, no-fault personal injury coverage for the insured/insured's car occupants, and physical damage coverage for an insured's own vehicle for collision or other perils. It also provides commercial automobile policies that offer insurance for commercial vehicles used for business purposes, including private passenger-type vehicles, trucks, tractors and trailers, and insure individual vehicles, as well as commercial fleets; and homeowners policies, which provide coverage for homes, condominiums, and apartments for losses to a dwelling and its contents from various perils, and coverage for liability to others arising from ownership or occupancy. In addition, the company offers business owners policies that cover apartments and residential condominiums, restaurants, office condominiums, processing and services businesses, special trade contractors, and wholesalers. Further, it provides personal umbrella policies, which provide personal excess liability coverage over and above the limits of individual automobile, watercraft, and homeowner's insurance policies; dwelling fire insurance for non-owner occupied residences; and commercial umbrella, which offers an excess liability product to clients. Additionally, the company offers inland marine coverage for homeowners and business owner policies; and watercraft coverage for small and medium sized pleasure crafts. It distributes its products through independent agents. The company was formerly known as Safety Holdings Inc and changed its name to Safety Insurance Group, Inc. in April 2002. Safety Insurance Group, Inc. was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts.
business_summary_ko: Safety Insurance Group, Inc.는 미국 매사추세츠에서 개인 승용차, 상업용 자동차, 주택 소유자 보험을 제공합니다. 회사는 타인의 신체 상해 및 재산 손해에 대한 보장, 피보험자/피보험자의 차량 탑승자를 위한 무과실 개인 부상 보장, 충돌 또는 기타 위험에 대한 피보험자 소유 차량의 물리적 손상 보장을 제공하는 개인 승용차 보험 상품을 제공합니다. 또한 개인 승용차, 트럭, 트랙터 및 트레일러를 포함하여 사업 목적으로 사용되는 상업용 차량에 대한 보험을 제공하고 개인 차량 및 상업용 차량을 보장하는 상업용 자동차 정책을 제공합니다. 주택, 콘도, 아파트에 대한 다양한 위험으로 인한 주택 및 그 내용물의 손실에 대한 보장과 소유권 또는 점유로 인해 발생하는 타인에 대한 책임 보장을 제공하는 주택 소유자 정책. 또한 회사는 아파트 및 주거용 콘도, 레스토랑, 사무실 콘도, 가공 및 서비스 업체, 특수 무역 계약자 및 도매업체를 포괄하는 사업주 정책을 제공합니다. 또한 개인 우산 정책을 제공합니다.
